newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH CBANK SAYS CROWN LEVEL MAY HAVE CREDIBILITY.
newsitem.headline: CZECH CBANK SAYS CROWN LEVEL MAY HAVE CREDIBILITY.

text.p: The Czech crown, hit hard early Tuesday after the central bank (CNB) eliminated the band within which it had moved against a mark/dollar basket, could have credibility at current levels, CNB spokesman Martin Svehla told Reuters.
At 0915 GMT, the crown was trading at 19.473 to the mark and 32.956 to the dollar, implying a deviation against its former basket of 10.89 percent below parity.
Before the central bank eliminated the +/-7.5 percent band, the crown was trading at -2.8 percent and was fixed against the mark at 18.078.
